usage: probe_measurement.py [-h] --repo REPO --output OUTPUT

Reproduce known behavior of one fixed archived revision with synthetic inputs.
No model, GPU, service, perf command, network request, or tracked repo
mutation. The C++ compilation below includes only a copied standard-library
median helper. This is an old-behavior reproducer, NOT a post-fix acceptance
or regression gate. Both --repo and a NEW --output directory are required.
Existing outputs are refused.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO      Repository checkout at HEAD
                   4ff68eba2d8c480692511dc6d219d27a6a102866; source hashes
                   must also match.
  --output OUTPUT  New output directory; must not exist, even if empty.
